faq_subtitle: PR.SOCIALについて知っておくべきすべて
faq_g1_a: PR.SOCIALは、Instagram、YouTube、TikTok、Telegram、X (Twitter)で簡単なタスク — フォロー、いいね、コメント、視聴 — を完了してお金を稼ぐソーシャルメディアプラットフォームです。
faq_g2_a: はい、登録は完全無料です。タスクを完了してお金を稼ぎます — 投資不要、サブスクリプション料金なし、隠された料金もありません。
faq_g3_q: どのプラットフォームがサポートされていますか？
faq_g3_a: 18のプラットフォームをサポートしています：Instagram、YouTube、TikTok、Telegram、X (Twitter)、Facebook、LinkedIn、Threads、Reddit、Quora、Snapchat、Likee、GitHub、Discord、Kick、Google Maps、Trustpilot、MAX。新しいプラットフォームは定期的に追加されます。
faq_g4_a: はい。PR.SOCIALは自発的にソーシャルメディアタスクを完了する実在の人々をつなぎます。bot、偽アカウント、無許可の自動化はありません。すべてのアクションは手動または公式ツール（アプリ、拡張機能、API）を通じて実行されます。
faq_e1_q: どうやって稼ぎ始めますか？
faq_e1_a:
1. 無料アカウントを作成
2. プロフィールに行き、ソーシャルメディアアカウントをリンク
3. アカウント認証を待つ（通常数分）
4. 利用可能なタスクを閲覧し完了し始める
5. 各承認されたタスクの後、残高が自動的に更新されます
faq_e2_q: タスクあたりいくら稼げますか？
faq_e2_a: 報酬はアクションタイプによって異なります。いいね：$0.002/タスク。フォロー、コメント、登録、その他：$0.004/タスク。収益は完了するタスク数によります。
faq_e3_q: タスク検証はどう動作しますか？
faq_e3_a: タスク完了後、証拠としてスクリーンショットをアップロードします。チームがアクションが正しく実行されたかレビューします。承認された場合、残高は自動的にクレジットされます。却下された場合、理由が表示され再度試すことができます。
faq_e4_q: 検証にどれくらい時間がかかりますか？
faq_e4_a: ほとんどのタスクは2〜5分以内に検証されます。ピーク時間中はわずかに時間がかかる場合がありますが、できるだけ早く全ての提出をレビューすることを目指しています。
faq_e5_q: 複数のソーシャルアカウントをリンクできますか？
faq_e5_a: プラットフォームごとに1アカウントをリンクできます。例：Instagram1アカウント、YouTube1アカウントなど。サポートされている18プラットフォームすべてを同時にリンクできます。各アカウントは個別に認証されます。
faq_promoting: アカウントを宣伝する
faq_p1_q: どうやってアカウントを宣伝しますか？
faq_p1_a:
1. メニューの「注文作成」へ
2. プラットフォームとアクションタイプを選択（フォロー、いいね、コメントなど）
3. ターゲットURLを入力（プロフィールまたは投稿リンク）
4. 数量を選択
5. 確認して残高から支払い

実在のユーザーがすぐにタスクを完了し始めます。
faq_p2_q: 宣伝の費用はいくらですか？
faq_p2_a: 価格はアクションあたり$0.01から始まります。正確な価格はプラットフォームとアクションタイプによります。注文を確認する前に合計コストが表示されます — サプライズはありません。
faq_p3_q: フォロワー/いいねは本物ですか？
faq_p3_a: はい、100%。各アクションは実在の人物が個人アカウントから実行します。各タスクには手動で検証されるスクリーンショット証拠が必要です。bot や偽エンゲージメントに対するゼロトレランスです。
faq_p4_q: どれくらい早く結果が見えますか？
faq_p4_a: 利用可能なワーカー数に応じて、注文作成後数分以内に結果が表示され始めます。ほとんどの注文は数時間以内に完了します。
faq_w1_q: どうやって収益を出金しますか？
faq_w1_a: ウォレット → 出金へ。最低：USDT BEP-20とToncoinは$2、TRXは$5。手数料：0%。処理時間：24〜48時間。
faq_w2_q: どうやって残高に資金を追加しますか？
faq_w2_a: ウォレットに行き「入金」をクリック。支払方法は拡張中で、暗号通貨、銀行カード、人気の支払システムが含まれます。
faq_w3_q: 最低出金額はありますか？
faq_w3_a: 最低出金額は$5です。プラットフォーム手数料はありません — 全額受け取れます。ブロックチェーンネットワーク手数料は方法によって適用される場合があります。
faq_referrals: リファラルプログラム
faq_r1_q: リファラルプログラムはどう動作しますか？
faq_r1_a: ユニークなリファラルリンクを友達と共有。彼らがサインアップしてタスクを完了すると、自動的に彼らのタスク収益の10%を稼ぎます。これは不労所得 — 彼らがプラットフォームでアクティブな限り続きます。
faq_r2_q: リファラル収益に制限はありますか？
faq_r2_a: 制限なし！望むだけ多くの人を招待でき、各タスク完了から10%を上限なく稼ぎます。
faq_r3_q: リファラルリンクはどこにありますか？
faq_r3_a: サイドバーメニューの「リファラル」ページへ。ユニークなリンクとリファラルコードがそこに表示され、リファラルと収益の統計も表示されます。
faq_s1_q: スクリーンショットが却下された場合は？
faq_s1_a: 却下理由が表示されます（例：「アクション不可視」、「スクリーンショットトリミング」）。より良いスクリーンショットで再提出できます。ヒント：フルスクリーンキャプチャを使用、ユーザー名と完了アクションが明確に表示されていることを確認。
faq_s2_q: 禁止されることはありますか？
faq_s2_a: はい。PR.SOCIALには警告システムがあります：3警告 = アカウント停止。警告は次の理由で発行：マルチアカウンティング、偽タスク完了、スパム、その他のルール違反。プラットフォームルールセクションで完全なリストを読めます。
faq_s3_a: メールとリンクされたソーシャルメディアユーザー名のみ保存します。パスワードは暗号化されます。ソーシャルメディアアカウントに直接アクセスすることはありません — すべてのアクションは自分で実行します。

guide_link_title: How to Link a Social Account
guide_link_intro: Follow these steps to link and verify your social media account:
guide_step1_text: Navigate to your Profile page from the sidebar. Scroll down to the "Social Media Accounts" section.
guide_step2_text: Click on any unlinked platform (e.g. Instagram, YouTube, TikTok). You can link one account per platform.
guide_step3_text: Enter your social media username and profile URL. Make sure your profile is PUBLIC — private profiles cannot be verified.
guide_step4_text: PR.SOCIAL gives you a unique verification code (e.g. prs_7a3c19). Add this code to your bio or profile description on the social media platform.
guide_step5_text: Take a screenshot showing the verification code in your bio. The screenshot must clearly show the social platform interface with the code visible.
guide_step6_text: Upload your screenshot. AI verifies it automatically — usually instant. If AI is unsure, it goes to manual review by admin (within 1 hour). You get up to 3 AI attempts before automatic manual review.
guide_telegram_text: Telegram accounts are linked via the bot @prsocialfree_bot. No screenshot needed — just follow the bot's instructions.
guide_change_text: You cannot unlink accounts yourself. To change a linked account, go to Profile → click the account → Request Change. An admin reviews each request individually.
guide_after_p1: Once your account is verified, you can:
guide_after_item1: Go to Available Tasks and start earning
guide_after_item2: Install free automation tools (Chrome Extension, Android App, Desktop App)

guide_twitter_about_p1: Twitter (now X) is a major microblogging platform. It offers the widest price range on PR.SOCIAL — from $0.002 likes to $0.007 retweets, the highest-paying regular task on the platform.
guide_twitter_about_p2: Retweets are the premium action at $0.007 each — over 3x more than a like. Twitter also offers crypto-themed comment tasks for the Web3 community. 7 task types available.
guide_twitter_tip1: Retweets pay $0.007 — the highest regular task rate on PR.SOCIAL. Prioritize these when available
guide_twitter_tip2: Your Twitter profile and tweets must be public — protected accounts cannot be verified
guide_twitter_tip3: Crypto comment tasks (comment_crypto) are Twitter-exclusive — they pay $0.004 and target Web3 content
guide_facebook_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows, likes, and comments
guide_facebook_about_p1: Facebook is the world's largest social network with nearly 3 billion monthly users. Facebook tasks on PR.SOCIAL include following pages, liking posts, and leaving comments.
guide_facebook_about_p2: Facebook offers steady task availability with 5 task types. Follow and comment tasks pay $0.004, while likes pay $0.002. A reliable platform for consistent earnings.
guide_facebook_tip1: Your Facebook profile must have public visibility for the relevant sections — follows and likes need to be visible
guide_facebook_tip2: When commenting on posts, write genuine comments relevant to the content — spam comments get rejected
guide_facebook_tip3: Use your real Facebook account — accounts with no profile photo or friends may be flagged during verification
guide_linkedin_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows, likes, and comments
guide_linkedin_about_p1: LinkedIn is the leading professional networking platform with over 900 million members. LinkedIn tasks on PR.SOCIAL focus on professional engagement — following profiles, liking posts, and commenting.
guide_linkedin_about_p2: LinkedIn tasks are business-oriented, making them ideal for workers who already have a professional profile. 5 task types available with standard pricing.
guide_linkedin_tip1: Your LinkedIn profile should look professional — a complete profile with photo increases verification success
guide_linkedin_tip2: Comments on LinkedIn should be professional and relevant to the post topic — casual replies may be rejected
guide_linkedin_tip3: LinkedIn engagement is visible to your network — keep this in mind when completing tasks
guide_threads_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows and likes
guide_threads_about_p1: Threads is Meta's text-based social platform, launched as an alternative to Twitter. It's integrated with Instagram and growing rapidly with millions of active users.
guide_threads_about_p2: Threads currently offers 2 task types on PR.SOCIAL: follows ($0.004) and likes ($0.002). As the platform grows, more task types may be added.
guide_threads_tip1: Threads is connected to your Instagram account — make sure your Instagram is already verified on PR.SOCIAL
guide_threads_tip2: Follow and like tasks on Threads are simple and quick — great for consistent micro-earnings
guide_threads_tip3: Keep your Threads profile public to ensure verification and task approval
guide_reddit_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows and upvotes
guide_reddit_about_p1: Reddit is the front page of the internet — a forum-based platform with thousands of communities (subreddits). It has over 1.7 billion monthly visitors.
guide_reddit_about_p2: Reddit offers 2 task types on PR.SOCIAL: following users ($0.004) and upvoting posts ($0.002). Quick, simple tasks suitable for workers familiar with Reddit.
guide_reddit_tip1: Your Reddit account should have some karma and age — brand new accounts may have limited functionality
guide_reddit_tip2: Upvote tasks are quick and easy — a good way to earn while browsing Reddit content
guide_reddit_tip3: Don't reverse your upvotes or unfollows after task completion — this triggers fraud detection
guide_quora_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows, upvotes, and comments
guide_quora_about_p1: Quora is the world's leading Q&A platform where people share knowledge on any topic. It has over 400 million monthly visitors.
guide_quora_about_p2: Quora offers 5 task types on PR.SOCIAL: follows, upvotes, and three types of comments. Follow and comment at $0.004, upvotes at $0.002.
guide_quora_tip1: Quora requires quality contributions — comments should be informative and relevant to the question
guide_quora_tip2: An established Quora profile with some answers improves your chance of task approval
guide_quora_tip3: Upvote tasks on Quora are quick and straightforward — great for consistent earnings between comment tasks
guide_snapchat_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows and likes
guide_snapchat_about_p1: Snapchat is a multimedia messaging app known for disappearing content, Stories, and AR filters. It has over 750 million monthly active users, especially popular among younger demographics.
guide_snapchat_about_p2: Snapchat offers 2 task types on PR.SOCIAL: follows ($0.004) and likes ($0.002). Simple tasks for workers who already use the platform.
guide_snapchat_tip1: Your Snapchat username must match what you enter during verification — double-check before submitting
guide_snapchat_tip2: Snapchat tasks are straightforward follows and likes — quick to complete with minimal effort
guide_snapchat_tip3: Keep your Snapchat profile settings accessible for verification purposes
guide_likee_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows and likes
guide_likee_about_p1: Likee is a short video creation and sharing platform with over 150 million monthly users. Popular in Southeast Asia, India, and other emerging markets.
guide_likee_about_p2: Likee offers 2 task types on PR.SOCIAL: follows ($0.004) and likes ($0.002). While task volume may be lower than major platforms, Likee tasks are quick to complete.
guide_likee_tip1: Likee is especially popular in South and Southeast Asia — workers in these regions may find more tasks available
guide_likee_tip2: Follow and like tasks on Likee work similarly to other video platforms — keep your profile active
guide_likee_tip3: Make sure your Likee profile is public and your username is correctly entered for verification
guide_discord_about_p1: Discord is a communication platform for communities, originally popular among gamers but now used by businesses, creators, and crypto projects. Over 200 million monthly active users.
guide_discord_about_p2: Discord offers 1 task type on PR.SOCIAL: joining servers at $0.004 each. While there's only one task type, Discord server joins are frequently requested by advertisers.
guide_discord_tip1: After joining a Discord server, stay for at least 24–48 hours — leaving too quickly results in task rejection
guide_discord_tip2: Some Discord servers require completing onboarding steps or rules acceptance — make sure to finish them
guide_discord_tip3: Keep your Discord account active and in good standing — banned or restricted accounts won't pass verification
guide_kick_about_p1: Kick is a live streaming platform and growing alternative to Twitch. Launched in 2022, it has attracted many top streamers with its creator-friendly revenue split.
guide_kick_about_p2: Kick offers 1 task type on PR.SOCIAL: following streamers at $0.004 each. A simple, straightforward platform for quick earnings.
guide_kick_tip1: Kick follows are simple — just follow the specified streamer's channel and keep the follow active
guide_kick_tip2: Don't unfollow streamers after completing the task — maintain your follow for at least 24 hours
guide_kick_tip3: Keep your Kick account profile complete with a username for successful verification
guide_github_subtitle: Earn $0.002–$0.004 per task: follows, stars, and forks
guide_github_about_p1: GitHub is the world's largest platform for software development and collaboration, with over 100 million developers. It hosts millions of open-source and private repositories.
guide_github_about_p2: GitHub offers 3 unique task types on PR.SOCIAL: following developers ($0.004), starring repositories ($0.002), and forking repositories ($0.002). Great for workers familiar with development tools.
guide_github_tip1: GitHub stars and forks are visible on your profile — these tasks are perfect for developers who use GitHub daily
guide_github_tip2: Fork tasks create a copy of the repository in your account — this is expected and normal behavior
guide_github_tip3: A GitHub account with some activity (repos, contributions) verifies more easily than an empty account
guide_google_maps_subtitle: Earn $0.50 per review — the highest-paying task on PR.SOCIAL
guide_google_maps_about_p1: Google Maps is the world's most used mapping and local business platform. Businesses depend on Google reviews for visibility and credibility, making reviews highly valued.
guide_google_maps_about_p2: Google Maps review tasks pay $0.50 each — 125x more than a simple like. This is the highest-paying task type on PR.SOCIAL. Reviews require more effort but the reward is substantial.
guide_google_maps_tip1: Write detailed, genuine reviews (at least 3–4 sentences) — short or generic reviews will be rejected
guide_google_maps_tip2: At $0.50 per review, even a few reviews per day generate significant earnings compared to other task types
guide_google_maps_tip3: Your Google account should have a history of reviews — accounts with no prior activity may be flagged
guide_trustpilot_subtitle: Earn $0.50 per review — premium review tasks
guide_trustpilot_about_p1: Trustpilot is a leading consumer review platform where people share experiences with businesses. Companies use Trustpilot ratings to build trust and attract customers.
guide_trustpilot_about_p2: Trustpilot review tasks pay $0.50 each — the same premium rate as Google Maps reviews. Write honest, detailed reviews for specified businesses. Fewer tasks available but much higher payout.
guide_trustpilot_tip1: Write authentic, detailed reviews with specific details about the service or product experience
guide_trustpilot_tip2: Your Trustpilot account should appear genuine — complete your profile and build some review history
guide_trustpilot_tip3: Trustpilot reviews are heavily moderated — make sure your review follows their community guidelines
guide_max_subtitle: Earn $0.004 per task: joins and comments
guide_max_about_p1: MAX is a community messaging platform. It's one of the newer platforms on PR.SOCIAL, focused on group communities and conversations.
guide_max_about_p2: MAX offers 4 task types on PR.SOCIAL: joining communities ($0.004) and three types of comments ($0.004 each). All tasks pay the standard $0.004 rate.
guide_max_tip1: Join tasks require staying in the community — don't leave immediately after completing the task
guide_max_tip2: Comment tasks on MAX work like other platforms — write relevant, meaningful comments to get approved
guide_max_tip3: MAX is a growing platform — task availability may vary but rates are competitive with other platforms

1. タスクをTikTokアカウント @{account} で実行しているか確認してください。

確認して1分後に「再確認」を押してください。

フォローして、1分後に「再確認」を押してください。
